name: X-Man XT3 V1 3x3 (Pioneer MagLev + UV)
description: The X-Man XT3 V1 3x3 (Pioneer MagLev + UV) is a 3x3 release from X-Man that gives you flagship features without the flagship price. Adjust the tension and compression and make this puzzle fit your turning style perfectly! This is the Pioneer MagLev + UV version that uses repelling magnets instead of springs. It also has a UV coating that adds a glossy outer finish that can aid with grip.
